read_flow_file: read an optical flow file in .flo, .png, or .pfm format and return a numpy array
write_flow_file: write an optical flow numpy array to a Middlebury .flo format file on disk
visualize_flow: visualize an optical flow array as a color-coded image using Ccbcr or RGB mode
evaluate_flow_error: evaluate the end point error between ground truth and predicted optical flow arrays
warp_image_with_flow: warp an image to the next frame using an optical flow map with cubic interpolation
